role: The bucket: on an empty bucket the look ray fills from a source water or lava block (func_150910_a swaps the stack or adds the full bucket), on a full bucket tryPlaceContainedLiquid pours at the adjacent cell (with the Nether water fizz), and the empty bucket is every filled bucket's container item.

members.name: isFull
members.note: the three rows 325/326/327 carry the same class_name; the full block is itemuse.c's is_full argument

members.name: onItemRightClick
members.note: the canMineBlock, canPlayerEdit, material + metadata-0 source checks and the side offset are all in bucket_rclick

members.name: func_150910_a
members.note: creative keeps the stack, last one swaps, otherwise the full bucket comes back as itemuse_try_use_item's give stack, which survival.c:give_or_drop adds to the inventory or drops (dropPlayerItemWithRandomChoice: throw_item on the server, the client EntityItem's draws on the client); iu-fill-s1

members.name: tryPlaceContainedLiquid
members.note: the air/nonsolid check, the Nether fizz (Det.mathRandom draws), func_147480_a (the replaced plant's drop through the player's world drop sink, serverreplay_drop_env_begin; none on the client) and the setBlock; iu-lava-s1 (tall grass, a flower, a snow layer, into water, a flowing lava refused); a client's own pour notifies no neighbour (World.func_147460_e is server-only, world.c notify_step), so its lava stays lava until the server's block change (sr3-cast-s1)

members.name: getContainerItem (via setContainerItem)
members.note: the furnace fuel slot gives back the empty bucket 325

notes: rc-items-s1 gates water and lava fill and pour; te-furnace-s1 gates the fuel-slot container item; test_itemuse.c compares both halves against the oracle's ItemUseProbe.
